senses.gloss: (cmp. חצב) to cut, mow (corresp. to h. קָצַר).
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Deuteronomy 24:19">Targ. Deut. XXIV, 19</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Moed Katan 9b:4">M. Kat. 9ᵇ</cite> <he>דתזרע ולא תִחְצַד</he> that you may sow but not cut (that your children may not die in your life time).

<cite ref="Taanit 10a:10">Taan. 10ᵃ</cite> <he>עתירה בבל דחַצְדָּא וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>עתידה … דחצרא</he>) Babylonia is rich because she harvests without rain (independent of rain-fall on account of her canalization).

<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 2:20:1">Koh. R. to II, 20</cite>; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 25">Lev. R. s. 25</cite> <he>קאים וחָצֵיד חצובין וכ׳</he> (<he>וחָצֵיב</he>, also <he>וחצד</he>, <he>והצב</he>) cutting down cistus shrubs to plant shoots of fig-trees; a. fr. [<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Demai 3:2:4">Y. Dem. III, 23ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>מיחצד</he>, <he>מחצדן</he>, v. <cite ref="H01517"><he>חֲצֵי</he></cite>.]
